functions.name: archive-manual-account
functions.description: Soft-close a manual account while preserving its transactions and balance history.

accountId.description: Finta ID of the manual account to soft-close.

FunctionInput_finta_archivemanualaccount.description: Manual account to soft-close while retaining its financial history.

id.description: Finta ID of the account whose close request succeeded.

status.description: Closed lifecycle state established by successful soft-close.

FunctionOutput_finta_archivemanualaccoun.description: Receipt for a successfully closed manual account.

tags.instructions: Get the ID from `list-accounts`. This closes only manual accounts, preserving their identity, transactions and balance history; it does not permanently erase them. Closed accounts are excluded from the default account list; use status closed or all to find them. No reopening task is available here.

functions.name: archive-transaction-rule
functions.description: Archive a transaction rule so that it no longer runs, while retaining the rule for inspection.

ruleId.description: Finta transaction rule UUID to archive.
Identifier of the rule whose archive request succeeded.

archived.description: True when Finta accepted the archive operation; it does not establish that previous transaction changes were undone.

FunctionOutput_finta_archivetransactionr.description: Acknowledgement that Finta accepted the rule archive operation.

tags.instructions: Obtain a rule ID from `list-transaction-rules` or `get-transaction-rule`. Archiving stops future rule execution but does not delete the rule. It remains readable with `get-transaction-rule` or with includeArchived in `list-transaction-rules`. No restore tool is available, and this does not promise to undo changes previously made to transactions.

functions.name: batch-update-categories
functions.description: Update up to 250 categories in one call, returning Finta's aggregate updated count. Unknown and Mercury read-only IDs are skipped.

categoryId.description: Finta category ID to update; unknown and read-only IDs are skipped by Finta.

group.description: Replacement group name; clearing group membership is not supported here.

description.description: Replacement explanation, or null to clear it.

changes.description: Partial changes for this target; omitted fields stay unchanged.

items.description: One category target and its partial changes.

updates.description: Distinct category updates to submit together; maximum 250 per call.

FunctionInput_finta_batchupdatecategorie.description: A batch of distinct category targets with partial changes.

updatedCount.description: Provider-reported number of records updated; does not identify targets or explain skipped records.

FunctionOutput_finta_batchupdatecategori.description: The aggregate number of categories Finta reports as updated.

tags.instructions: Get IDs with `list-categories`. Supply 1–250 distinct category targets; use `update-category` when you need one resulting record or a target-specific error. Omitted change fields stay unchanged; description null clears it. Unknown and read-only targets are skipped, and the aggregate result does not identify which targets changed. Inspect `list-categories` if you need verification.

functions.name: batch-update-transactions
functions.description: Set or clear transaction categories for up to 250 transactions in one native batch request, returning the provider's aggregate updated count.

transactionId.description: Finta transaction UUID to modify; must be distinct within this request.

categoryId.description: Finta category UUID to assign, or explicit null to remove the category; omission is not a no-op option.

items.description: An explicit category assignment or clearing for one transaction.

updates.description: Category changes for 1 through 250 distinct transactions, submitted in one native batch; duplicate transaction IDs are not allowed.

FunctionInput_finta_batchupdatetransacti.description: A single batch of explicit transaction category changes.

updated.description: Provider-reported number of records updated; does not identify which requested transactions changed or establish that every requested ID existed.

FunctionOutput_finta_batchupdatetransact.description: The aggregate updated count reported by Finta, without per-transaction outcomes.

tags.instructions: Use this for 1 to 250 transaction category changes; use `update-transaction` for one transaction when you need its full resulting record. Obtain transaction IDs from `list-transactions` and category IDs from `list-categories`. Each transaction must appear only once. Null clears a category. The result is an aggregate count, not per-transaction success, and atomic processing is not promised.

functions.description: Create a rule that matches stored transactions and assigns a category, changes merchant names, or hides matching transactions. Account restrictions of the connection apply.

type.description: Assign a category to each matching transaction.

categoryId.description: Finta category UUID; the integration resolves its current display name.

anyOf.description: Assign a category to matching transactions.

type.description: Replace each matching transaction's merchant name.

merchantName.description: Ordinary Unicode merchant-name text, including an empty string if Finta accepts it; no transport encoding is required.

type.description: Hide each matching transaction from default transaction listings; this is not deletion.

anyOf.description: Hide matching transactions without deleting them.

outcomes.description: Actions to apply to matching transactions, submitted in the supplied order.

priority.description: Rule priority from 1 through 100. Omit to use Finta's default; precedence direction is not inferred.

field.description: Transaction attribute to compare. Account values are Finta account UUIDs; transactionDay denotes a provider-defined transaction-day value.

value.description: Comparison value: ordinary text for text fields, an account UUID for account, or an unscaled provider-native number for amount or transactionDay. No timestamp or currency-unit conversion is inferred.

operator.description: Comparison to perform. Contains is for text, and greaterThan/lessThan are for numeric values; supported upstream operator mappings require validation.

items.description: A transaction attribute comparison.

conditions.description: Conditions to submit in order; their combination follows Finta's rule semantics, not a caller-selected Boolean grouping.

FunctionInput_finta_createtransactionrul.description: A reusable transaction rule with ordered conditions and actions.

id.description: Identifier of the created transaction rule.

items.description: A stored Finta action.

outcomes.description: Outcomes as stored by Finta, preserving action-specific members as structured JSON.

priority.description: Stored priority, including Finta's default when no priority was supplied.

createdAt.description: Creation instant normalized to UTC Z without fractional precision loss.

updatedAt.description: Modification instant normalized to UTC Z without fractional precision loss.

archivedAt.description: Archive instant in UTC Z, or null when active.

additionalProperties.description: A stored expression member as JSON.

items.description: A stored Finta condition expression.

conditions.description: Conditions as stored by Finta, preserved as structured domain expressions, including provider-specific members.

items.description: An account identifier assigned by Finta.

allowedAccountIds.description: Account restrictions assigned by Finta; null means all accounts and differs from an empty array.

FunctionOutput_finta_createtransactionru.description: The created rule as stored by Finta, without claiming existing transactions were updated.

tags.instructions: Use this to define reusable transaction automation, not to categorize one transaction directly; use `update-transaction` for that. Creation does not establish when automatic application occurs, and repeating the call may create another rule.
